label: class_g_08_math_01
text: The time has come to test how well you all have\nlearned in my class![VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: class_g_08_math_02
text: Let’s begin before the information simmering in\nyour brains from a last-minute cram session fades.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: class_g_08_question_01
text:
1. Which of the following Meal Powers makes it
    easier to come across Shiny Pokémon?

A) Sparkling Power
B) Encounter Power
C) Catching Power

label: class_g_08_ansewer_01a
text: A) Sparkling Power

label: class_g_08_ansewer_01b
text: B) Encounter Power

label: class_g_08_ansewer_01c
text: C) Catching Power

label: class_g_08_question_02
text:
2. Which of the following is NOT an effect of
    Egg Power?

A) It makes Eggs hatch faster
B) It helps hatch strong Pokémon
C) It makes Eggs easier to find

label: class_g_08_ansewer_02a
text: A) It makes Eggs hatch faster

label: class_g_08_ansewer_02b
text: B) It helps hatch strong Pokémon

label: class_g_08_ansewer_02c
text: C) It makes Eggs easier to find

label: class_g_08_question_03
text:
3. What is a simple yet important tactic for
    increasing the effectiveness of Meal Powers?

A) Make food more often
B) Make food at home
C) Make food with others

label: class_g_08_ansewer_03a
text: A) Make food more often

label: class_g_08_ansewer_03b
text: B) Make food at home

label: class_g_08_ansewer_03c
text: C) Make food with others

label: class_g_08_question_04
text:
4. What is the correct action to take when your
    adorable Pokémon become dirty?

A) Pokémon Wash
B) Pokémon Dash
C) Pokémon Wish

label: class_g_08_ansewer_04a
text: A) Pokémon Wash

label: class_g_08_ansewer_04b
text: B) Pokémon Dash

label: class_g_08_ansewer_04c
text: C) Pokémon Wish

label: class_g_08_question_05
text:
5. This is a question about academy rules. Should
    you change your uniform tops and bottoms to
    properly match each season?

A) Yes, you should
B) It doesn’t matter

label: class_g_08_ansewer_05a
text: A) Yes, you should

label: class_g_08_ansewer_05b
text: B) It doesn’t matter

label: class_g_08_math_03
text: The time for answering questions has come to an\nend. Please stop writing.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: class_g_08_math_04
text: I...made the questions a little easier than I’d\nplanned to, as a way of saying thank you for\r\ninforming me about Rotom Phone cases.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: class_g_08_math_05
text: I trust that you all gave this exam everything you\nhad so that you will not have to retake it.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: class_g_08_math_06
text: Please remember to ask for your scores at the\nfront desk before leaving for the day.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
